title: Separate Coinbase revenue/counterparty concentration from Circle reserve and issuer-control metrics

decisions.rule: Record disclosed concentration with identity unknown; never infer that the unnamed counterparty is Circle, Ripple, Binance or a market maker.
Keep U.S. revenue share and stablecoin revenue geography separate from global trading-volume share and customer assets on platform.
Access-denied tokens are excluded from USDC circulation; freezing does not extinguish the holder liability or mean assets have been recovered.
Separate money-market-fund exposure, bank deposits, FDIC coverage and stablecoin-holder liabilities; do not label the entire reserve as cash or insured deposits.

feature_admission: NONE; Coinbase counterparty concentration and Circle reserve structure are institutional/macro context features, not native-XRP demand features.
